headline.zh: 茶咖融合的全天候大花园
headline.en: All-day garden cafe with tea-infused coffee

traits.zh: 用碧螺春、龙井、普洱做茶咖
traits.en: Coffee infused with Biluochun, Longjing, Pu'er

traits.zh: 招牌含桂花拿铁和手工焦糖南瓜重芝士蛋糕
traits.en: Signature drinks and cakes include osmanthus latte and pumpkin cheesecake

traits.zh: 门店多为超千平，含绿植造景与户外露营区
traits.en: Stores often exceed 1000 sqm with greenery and outdoor camping areas

traits.zh: 营业覆盖早咖到晚餐+微醺时段
traits.en: Open from morning coffee through dinner and drinks

traits.zh: 2015年从陶家宅民宿自然生长出的咖啡简餐品牌
traits.en: Grew organically from a 2015 homestay in Taojia Village

linger.zh: 大空间+全天营业适合久坐

adventure.zh: 茶咖融合属非传统做法
